The '''Kerest system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerest/Legends|Kerest]], the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian's]] homeworld, and the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Karoliston]] and [[Pharna]]. An unusual period of activity of the sun forced the Kerestians to abandon their colonies on these moons.<ref name="GG12" />
